extracted.intended_audience: Principal investigators, research administrators, and grant applicants preparing NIH Research & Related Budget and Current & Pending/Other Support (PA-20-203) submissions
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and complete NIH Research & Related (R&R) budget forms (Sections A–K) across budget periods and accurately compile Current & Pending Support / Other Support entries describing active and pending projects, effort, and overlap disclosures for an NIH grant application (Funding Opportunity PA-20-203).

rubrics_metrics.name: Current & Pending Support – complete disclosure of active and pending projects
rubrics_metrics.description: List all active and pending support for the contact PD/PI and other senior/key personnel, including project title, source (agency), role (e.g., PI, Co-I), project period (start and end dates), total award amount where indicated, and effort (calendar months or calendar months/percentage).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document shows examples: include role (e.g., 'Role: Co-Investigator'), project dates (e.g., '09/01/19-08/31/21'), and effort (e.g., '1.20 calendar', '0.24 calendar'). Indicate PENDING vs ACTIVE and explicitly state 'OVERLAP' information. Provide 'Current and Pending Support' separate pages and ensure there is no scientific or budgetary overlap or disclose how overlap will be handled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Support / Foreign and Collaborative Disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Report 'Other Support' including institutional appointments, multi-institutional collaborations, international funding, and any foreign affiliations or foreign talent program participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example items: UW appointment FTE and dual appointments across institutions, co-investigator roles on international grants, and explicit statements such as 'Dr. Sondel is not part of any foreign talent program.' For international collaborative funding, disclose the collaborating countries, funding sources, amounts, and the portion to the UW subaward and effort (calendar months).

rubrics_metrics.name: Overlap disclosure and effort adjustments
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether there is scientific or budgetary overlap among listed projects and, if a pending award will be funded, describe how effort will be reduced on other grants to accommodate the new award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples in the file: 'There is no scientific overlap on any of the above grants.' and conditional statements: 'If the pending P01 grant is funded, Dr. Sondel plans to decrease his effort from the following four grants to accommodate the additional 1.2 calendar months on the P01' with specific reductions listed. Explicitly state planned effort reallocation and new calendar months for affected projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget form — Identification and budget period fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide organization name, budget type (Project or Subaward/Consortium), start and end dates, and budget period number for each Research & Related budget attachment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields shown: 'Enter name of Organization', 'Budget Type*: ● Project ❍ Subaward/Consortium', 'Start Date*: 09-01-2021', 'End Date*: 08-31-2022', and 'Budget Period: 1'. Repeat for each budget period (the PDF shows Budget Periods 1–5).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget form Section A — Senior/Key Person details and effort
rubrics_metrics.description: List each senior/key person with prefix, first/middle/last name, project role (e.g., PD/PI), base salary, and months of effort (calendar, academic, summer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: 'David Al-Adra PD/PI 9' and 'Total Funds Requested for all Senior Key Persons in the attached file'. Include salary ($), fringe benefits ($), and compute funds requested. Ensure effort is reported as calendar months (e.g., '9.00 calendar months' or '75% effort, 9.00 calendar months').

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget form Section B — Other personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: List all other personnel with project role, months of effort (calendar/academic/summer), requested salary, fringe benefits, and funds requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide number of personnel and totals. The form includes placeholders for 'Number of Personnel', 'Project Role*', and totals for salaries and fringe. Attach supporting files where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section C — Equipment reporting threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: List equipment items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Field: 'List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000' and 'Total funds requested for all equipment listed in the attached file'. Provide itemized equipment descriptions and include equipment requested across budget periods (the sample repeats C for each year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section D — Travel costs categorization
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide separate line items for domestic travel costs (including Canada, Mexico, and U.S. possessions) and foreign travel costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields shown: '1. Domestic Travel Costs (Incl. Canada, Mexico, and U.S. Possessions)' and '2. Foreign Travel Costs'. Include funds requested for each and any justification in the budget justification file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section E — Participant/Trainee support costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize participant/trainee support costs including tuition/fees/health insurance, stipends, travel, subsistence, and other participant support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields: '1. Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance; 2. Stipends; 3. Travel; 4. Subsistence; 5. Other'. Also report 'Number of Participants/Trainees' and total participant trainee support costs. The sample shows 0.00 where not applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sections F–K — Other direct costs, direct costs totals, and indirect costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize other direct costs (materials/supplies, publication costs, consultant services, ADP/computer services, subawards/consortium costs, equipment/facility rental, alterations/renovations, tuition remission), compute total direct costs (A–F), and calculate indirect costs (type, rate, base, funds requested).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form fields include listing of F categories and then 'G. Direct Costs', 'H. Indirect Costs' with 'Indirect Cost Type', 'MTDC' example, 'Indirect Cost Rate (%)', 'Indirect Cost Base ($)', and 'Cognizant Federal Agency'. Provide totals for direct + indirect and any fee/J&A file attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget justification — required narrative / attachment
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Budget Justification narrative as a single attachment that explains personnel roles, percent effort, fringe benefits, supplies, equipment, and other costs. Only attach one file for the budget justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample includes a 'BUDGET JUSTIFICATION' section with Personnel descriptions (PI, mentors with 'no salary requested', other personnel with percent effort and calendar months), fringe rates (e.g., 33.6%), and detailed line items for supplies and services (histology, flow cytometry, nanosight imaging microscope). The form notes 'Budget_Justification1039439100.pdf (Only attach one file.)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel descriptions and mentor disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: In the budget justification, describe each key person's role, percent effort, qualifications, and mentoring arrangements (mentors may be listed with 'no salary requested').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'David Al-Adra, MD, PhD, Principal Investigator (75% effort, 9.00 calendar months)' with role responsibilities; mentors listed with titles, research focus, prior funding, frequency of meetings (weekly/monthly) and mentoring roles. Include fringe benefit rates for paid personnel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplies/Other expenses — itemized categories and year-by-year costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize supplies and other expenses by category (cell isolation consumables, cell culture consumables, pre-operative/operative disposables, perfusion additives & consumables, histology service fees, flow cytometry service fees, imaging equipment) and indicate year-specific costs (Y1, Y2–Y5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide short lists of included items under each budget line (e.g., 'cell isolation consumables (glass slides, cell strainers, tubes)') and, where service rates are known, include hourly rates (example: 'Flow Cytometry core facility cost of $65/hour') and approximate total hours/costs for specific aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form administrative fields and attachment metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete administrative and tracking fields including OMB number/expiration date, Funding Opportunity Number (PA-20-203), Received Date, Organizational DUNS, Tracking Number, File Name, and Mime Type for attached budget and justification files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples on the pages: 'OMB Number: 4040-0010 Expiration Date: 12/31/2022', 'Funding Opportunity Number: PA-20-203 . Received Date: 2020-11-04T09:42:09.000-05:00', 'Tracking Number: GRANT13237812', and 'Budget_Justification1039439100.pdf Mime Type: application/pdf'. Ensure these metadata fields are populated when submitting.
